release_notes.en-US: First Firefox release. Copy a cleaned short URL of the current page or any link: tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, etc.) are removed and site-specific rules keep only meaningful parameters. Facebook/TikTok share short-links are resolved to their real URLs. Also unlocks right-click and selection on sites that block it.
release_notes.zh-TW: 首個 Firefox 版本。一鍵複製當前頁面或任何連結的乾淨短網址：自動移除追蹤參數（utm_*、fbclid、gclid 等），依網站規則只保留有意義的參數；Facebook／TikTok 分享短連結會自動解析為真實網址；另可解鎖右鍵與文字選取。

version.approval_notes:
Same extension as the Chrome Web Store listing 'Short URL Copier' (cmcmnlopagkmeackpmhfipcefeinaffg), ported to Firefox MV3 (background event page). Source: https://github.com/Oliver0804/chrome_plugin_shortURL

Permission justification:
- host_permissions <all_urls> + content script: the extension shows an optional floating bubble and context-menu item on any page to copy the current/link URL after cleaning; rules are all client-side (see URL_RULES in background.js).
- clipboardWrite: writes the cleaned URL to the clipboard. clipboardRead: an explicit user action ('clean clipboard URL') reads the clipboard to clean a URL the user copied.
- Background fetch to facebook.com / tiktok.com (redirect: follow) resolves /share/ and vt/vm.tiktok.com short links to their real URLs; results cached in chrome.storage.session (cleared when the browser closes).
- No analytics, no remote code, no data leaves the browser except the short-link redirect fetches described above.
